title: Explorer address parsing
responsibility: Parses and formats branch or commit explorer addresses with category, entity, section and tab selection.

inputs.name: explorerKindCategory.kind
inputs.description: Declared unit kind to map into a displayed category.

inputs.name: explorerRoute.path
inputs.description: Console-relative path beginning with an encoded branch segment or full lowercase 40-character commit hash; trailing slashes are ignored.

inputs.name: explorerRoute.search
inputs.description: Optional query string containing tab selection; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: explorerRoutePath.location
inputs.description: Branch or commit scope and category, with optional entity, details/history section and tab.

outputs.name: explorerCategories
outputs.description: Navigation categories in order: pages, shells, components, functions, configs and services.

outputs.name: explorerKindCategory
outputs.description: Mapped category, or null for an unsupported kind; only shell maps to shells.

outputs.name: explorerSections
outputs.description: Supported entity sections: details and history; omitted section means overview.

outputs.name: explorerTabs
outputs.description: Allowed tabs by section. Overview includes overview, used-in, uses, relationships and tests; details includes contract, measurements and source; history has none.

outputs.name: explorerRoute
outputs.description: Parsed location, or undefined for malformed scope, encoding, category or selection. A bare branch or commit opens Pages; invalid/default tabs are omitted.

outputs.name: explorerRoutePath
outputs.description: Canonical path with encoded branch/entity segments, selected helper identity and valid nondefault tab in the query.
